posts.text: BREAKING: Iran has weighed attacking US Military targets in Europe should President Trump escalate the war, per FT. Details include: 1. Iranian forces have reportedly assessed striking US assets in south-eastern European countries such as Bulgaria 2. Cyprus, where a British air base was struck by a drone in March, was also among potential targets for retaliation in the event of any renewed US offensive 3. Iranian forces have also reportedly considered attacking subsea fiber-optic cables in the Strait of Hormuz in the event of an escalation Iran is ready to expand its range of targets should the war escalate again.
